summary: Iteration 56 - Tested user directory endpoint, location venues with external venues, bi-monthly/quarterly recurrence options, outreach programme location/venue selectors, guest delete, portal page, and major pages. All features working correctly.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_Recurrence_Programme for testing recurring events dialog
context_for_next_testing_agent: All iteration 56 features verified: (1) GET /api/admin/users/directory returns all users regardless of campus filter - used by TasksPage for assignee resolution. (2) GET /api/locations/{id}/venues includes external venues (is_external=true or no location_id). (3) OutreachPage programme form has Campus/Location and Venue selectors with location-based venue loading. (4) Bi-monthly and quarterly recurrence options added to both EventsPage and OutreachPage recurring events dialogs. (5) Guest delete works via individual Trash button. (6) Portal page loads correctly. (7) Kiosk page loads correctly. (8) All major pages (Dashboard, Tasks/Boards, Events, Outreach, Admin, People) load without errors.
